title: Harry Reid's request for SAP status denied by William Lynn

tellings.quote: Harry Reid was trying to get deputy secretary defense William Lynn to give us an sap and William Lyn denied his request

plain: The physicist Eric W. Davis says that in 2009, Senator Harry Reid wrote to the deputy secretary of defense, William Lynn, asking him to make the UFO research Davis was part of a special access program, which is the most tightly guarded kind of secret government project. Davis says Lynn turned the request down. He tells this as an insider, and he points to Reid's letter to Lynn. If true, it means the work was refused the extra secrecy and protection Reid wanted for it.
